messages.content: i have a free morning tomorrow. i want to go to the library, but i do not want to spend the whole morning looking for books.
you could choose what you want before leaving home. do you have a specific book in mind, or would you like to find something about a general idea?
i want a short story to read with my father. he likes stories about people going on a journey.
then you can ask for a short story about a journey. you might look at one page together before choosing, so you both know whether you like the writing.
he will not be with me at the library. i am going alone.
then you can look at a page yourself and choose something you think he might enjoy. if you are not sure where to start, ask a worker for help finding a short story about a journey.
i also need to return a book. should i do that first?
that could work well. return the book first, then you can look for the next one without carrying the old one around.
what can i say to ask for help?
i am looking for a short story to read with my father. he enjoys stories about a journey. could you help me find one?
make it shorter, but keep the journey part.
could you help me find a short story about a journey?
what should i tell my father when i get home?
you could say: i found a book we might enjoy reading together. would you like to look at it with me?
my son made up a game with a ball. he wants to teach me, but he says everything at once and i cannot follow.
you could ask him to show you how to start, then play that part together. after you understand the first part, ask what comes next.
i do not want him to think his game is wrong.
you can make the question about your understanding: i want to learn your game. could you show me the first thing i should do?
he says i stand by the chair and give him the ball. then he runs to the door.
then you know how to begin. you stand by the chair, give him the ball, and watch him run to the door. you can ask what you should do after that.
he says wait until he comes back. i thought i had to follow him.
now that part is clear. you wait by the chair while he runs to the door and back. you do not follow him in that part of the game.
can you put what i know into one short explanation?
you stand by the chair and give him the ball. he runs to the door and comes back while you wait.
we have not talked about who keeps the ball when he comes back.
then leave that part open and ask him. you could say: when you come back, do you keep the ball or give it to me?
he says he gives it to me and then we change places.
then after he comes back, he gives you the ball. you change places, and you can ask whether it is now your turn to run.
a friend sent me a long message after we had not talked for a week. i want to answer, but i cannot write much today.
you can send a short reply now and say you want to read and answer more later. that can let your friend know you got the message without making you write everything at once.
i read it already. i just have not had time to think about all of it.
then say that rather than saying you still need to read it. you could write: i read your message. thank you for telling me. i want a little time to think before i answer more.
i want it to sound less like a letter from an office.
i read what you sent. thank you for telling me. i want time to think about what you said and would like to talk more later.
keep it about one important thing, rather than everything they said.
i read what you sent. thank you for telling me. i want to think about it before i say more.
can i add that i care without saying i know how they feel?
yes. you could add: i care about you, and i am happy you told me. you do not have to say you know their feelings to say you care.
give just the sentence about how i care.
i care about you, and i am happy you told me.
i do not know when i can talk. should i still say tomorrow?
if you do not know, you can leave the time open. say you want to talk more when you have time, rather than choosing tomorrow just to give a day.
my wife comes home from work before i do. we want to eat together, but she is hungry when she gets in.
could she have a little food when she comes home, then eat the meal with you later? you can ask whether that would work for her before choosing it together.
she says that works. i can cook when i get back, but i do not want her to wait for me to start everything.
you could choose a simple meal before work and get what you need ready. when you come home, you can start cooking without first choosing what to make.
i can wash the vegetables in the morning. she said she can put the rice on before i come home.
then you each have a part. you wash the vegetables in the morning, she starts the rice later, and you finish the meal when you get home.
what if i have to work late?
you can let her know as soon as you know. then she can choose whether to eat before you come home. eating together can be a plan without making her wait while hungry.
write a short message for that day.
i will be home later than i thought. please eat if you are hungry. i would still like to sit with you when i get back.
does sit with you mean she has to eat again?
no. sitting together does not mean both people must be eating. she can have finished her meal and still spend time with you while you eat.
i want to draw my old house and my new house on one page. they are far apart in real life. can they be next to each other in the picture?
yes. you can put them near each other to show that both are part of your life. a picture can bring ideas together without being a map of where everything really is.
i want the old house on the left and the new one on the right. what could go in the middle?
what would you like the middle to say? it could show the journey between them, or something you remember from both places.
we took the same table with us. i remember eating at it in both places.
then the table could be in the middle as something that was part of both places. you could draw it once, with something from each house near it.
would drawing it in two places mean i have two real objects?
not by itself. the picture could show the same table at one time and then at another. if you want the meaning clear, you can write that it is the same table in both places.
i want just one table in the drawing. give me a short explanation to put below it.
two places, one table, and many meals together.
i do not know if many is right. we only moved yesterday.
then keep it about the same table without saying how many meals you had: the same table in our old house and our new one.
i read a story at school today. yesterday i could not understand the first page. today i read three pages. does that mean i understand the whole book now?
it says you got through more pages today. it does not yet tell us how much you understood or whether you know the whole story. could you tell someone what happened in those three pages?
i can tell what happened, but there is one sentence i do not understand.
then you understand part of what you read and have one sentence to work on. you can ask about that sentence without saying you understood nothing.
i sometimes think if one part is hard, the whole thing was wrong.
one hard part does not make every other part wrong. you can keep what you understood and work on the part that is still not clear.
what could i ask my teacher?
i understand what happened in these pages, but this sentence is not clear to me. could you explain it in another way?
should i show the sentences before it too?
yes, those can help. a sentence can use information from what came before it, so you can show that part to make your question clear.
what if i still do not understand the explanation?
you can say which part is still hard and ask for an example. you do not have to say you understand before you really do.
can i be happy about reading more even if i need help?
yes. you read more and found a specific question to ask. asking for help with one part does not take away the work you did.
my brother likes music while he works. i like a quiet room when i read. we use the same room in the evening.
you could talk about when each of you needs the room. is there another place where one of you could work, or do you both need to be there at the same time?
we both need that room. we cannot choose another place this evening.
then you can talk about time rather than place. could you have a quiet part of the evening for reading and another part when he can play music?
he needs to finish before dinner. i can read after dinner, but i wanted to start now.
you have a choice between starting now with music and waiting for quiet later. you can tell him what you want while also asking when he will finish.
i do not want to say he never thinks about me.
then keep the message about today: i wanted some quiet to read now. when do you think you will finish your work?
he says he can turn the music off for a little while. what should i answer?
you could say: thank you. a little quiet time would help me get started. please tell me when you need the music again.
why not say the problem will never happen again?
you have a plan for part of this evening. that does not say what will work every evening. you can see how this goes and talk again another day.
write a short question for tomorrow.
what would be a good time for quiet reading in the room tomorrow?
picoboi, help me keep a simple plan clear. i will visit my aunt tomorrow morning and go to the shop after lunch.
your plan is to visit your aunt tomorrow morning, then go to the shop after lunch.
now my aunt says the afternoon is better. i will go to the shop in the morning instead.
then the new plan is to go to the shop tomorrow morning and visit your aunt in the afternoon.
which part of the plan changed?
the time for each visit changed. the shop moved to the morning, and the visit to your aunt moved to the afternoon. both are still tomorrow.
did i say i would have lunch with my aunt?
no. you said you would visit in the afternoon. you did not say where you would have lunch or who would be with you.
what if i ask you to add lunch with her?
then i can add that to the plan, but it would be new information from you. it was not part of what you had already said.
add it now. i will have lunch with her, then stay for the afternoon.
you will go to the shop tomorrow morning, have lunch with your aunt, and stay with her for the afternoon.
can you ask whether i want to bring anything without choosing what it is?
would you like to bring anything when you visit your aunt?
yes, a cake. give me the whole plan in one sentence.
tomorrow morning you will go to the shop, then bring a cake when you visit your aunt for lunch and the afternoon.
